## Summary

- 2.5+ years in production at Halodoc (Feb 2024 – present).
- Builds Java microservices and Kafka pipelines that ingest and reconcile high-volume financial data from pharmacies, insurers, payment gateways and banks.
- Strong in SQL performance (EXPLAIN-driven indexing, N+1 elimination, batched writes), production incident ownership and observability-led debugging (Dynatrace).
- Builds Claude Code agentic skills used across the team to find and fix problems end to end, including tests and merge requests.

## Selected results

- Cut LCP on halodoc.com/tanya-dokter from 7.0 s to under 2.5 s (Angular SSR, TransferState, preload injection).
- Found a production query scanning 2.6M rows to return about 500; root-caused 5–13 s API and Kafka consumer latency.
- Eliminated N+1 queries across 4 reconciliation microservices with 100% new-code branch coverage.
- Cut a production 4xx error ticket queue from 90 to 1 with a Dynatrace DQL sweep.
- Removed a ~12 s slow aggregation query; led recovery from an ingestion outage including schema verification and backfill.
